question: Cotton is used in making clothes. In this example, cotton is which type of good?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Intermediate**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Cotton is an intermediate good** because it is used to produce another good, fabric, which is then used to make clothing.
 
• **Intermediate goods**
 
 
• **​**These **are goods that are used to produce other goods. **
 
• **They are also known as producer goods or semi-finished product**s. 
 
 
 
• Cotton **is a natural fiber that is strong and absorbent. **
 
• It is** used to make many things, including clothes, homewares, and industrial products. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 
 
 
 
 

 Option
 Definition
 
 

 Inferior Good
 Goods for which demand decreases as income increases.
 
 

 Capital Good
 Goods used to produce other goods but are not part of the final product (e.g., machinery).
 
 

 Giffen Good
 Inferior goods with the peculiar characteristic that their demand increases as their price rises.
